alt: A hyper-realistic sculpted cake of a cooked lobster in vivid glossy red tones with segmented tail, articulated legs, textured carapace, and tiny black eyes, positioned on a white block with wooden skewers piercing through the claws.

A sculpted cake designed as a freshly baked square pepperoni pizza inside an open cardboard box, with melted cheese bubbles, glossy curled pepperoni slices glistening with rendered fat, white onion pieces peeking through, and a golden-brown crust.

A hyper-realistic sculpted cake featuring a dark glass wine bottle labeled "1968 VINTAGE — Aged to Perfection" with a laurel wreath, alongside an artfully arranged charcuterie board on a rustic wooden platter with Swiss cheese, brie, salami, crackers, olives, grapes, and fresh herbs.

An elaborate fire truck cake sculpted to resemble a classic red fire engine with silver accents on windows, wheels, and structural elements, yellow lights on top, set on a rectangular base mimicking asphalt with vibrant translucent flames made from edible gelatin or sugar glass illuminated from within.

A cake designed to resemble two folded New York Mets baseball jerseys on an orange textured board — the top jersey in royal blue fondant with bold orange and white "Mets" script, beneath it a white pinstriped jersey with the name "REY" in navy-blue block letters.

A hyper-realistic sculpted cake of a classic cheeseburger and fries — thick dark brown beef patty with bright yellow melted cheese and red ketchup, layered between pale green lettuce and red tomato slice, topped with a golden-brown sesame seed bun, all on a platter piled with golden-brown french fries.

A sculpted cake featuring iconic New York Yankees baseball memorabilia — a brown leather-style baseball glove, a white baseball with red stitching, and a navy blue Yankees cap with the classic interlocking "NY" logo — all resting atop a smooth white-frosted cylindrical cake base with repeating Yankees logos.

A rustic Western-themed cake featuring a large realistic cowboy hat crafted from fondant resting atop a stack of colorful striped fabric resembling a blanket or saddle pad, with a coiled twine rope, layered blocks in vibrant stripes of yellow, red, blue, and black, a translucent glass of amber liquid, and a "WANTED" poster for "Carmine Pace Iantorno."

A vibrant textured cake decorated to resemble a psychedelic tiger's face against a bright green frosted background, with bold multicolored stripes in blues, purples, oranges, pinks, and greens blending into a tie-dye effect, thick piped frosting adding depth to the tiger's yellow eyes, nose, whiskers, and stripes.

A sculpted cake of a leaping trout captured mid-air breaking through stylized water, the fish rendered with golden-olive back speckled with black spots, vibrant pink lateral stripe, and translucent fins, emerging from a dynamic splash of clear resin-like material mimicking frothy water atop a cylindrical base painted in swirling blue and turquoise.

A sculpted cake figurine of a man with an oversized expressive head, wide bright blue eyes, and a knowing smirk, wearing a royal blue tailcoat with white cuffs, vibrant yellow waistcoat with dark buttons, bold red bow tie, seated on a brick ledge.
A metallic-styled lighthouse cake sculpture featuring a tall tower with bird accents and a boat with a ladder and smokestack, set on a blue base resembling ocean waves.
A colorful clay sculpture of a hippie-style rabbit wearing a headband and tie-dye shirt, sitting on a mushroom and holding a rainbow peace sign.

caption: King of the Lions Cake
alt: A realistic lion head cake with a sculpted, textured mane in shades of golden brown and cream, featuring detailed painted facial features including amber eyes, a pink nose, and black whiskers, set against a black background.

caption: Lion Cake
alt: A realistic sculpted cake featuring a male lion's head with a golden mane and white beard, set against a green background and signed by the artist in the bottom right corner.

caption: Staple Center
alt: A detailed cake sculpture features a replica of the Staples Center arena perched atop a basketball, accompanied by a Lakers jersey with the number 24 and a sneaker, all set on a court-themed base.

caption: Beer and Snacks Grooms Cake
alt: A novelty cake designed to look like a wooden crate overflowing with a bag of Wise potato chips and Kit Kat bars, with five fondant Heineken beer cans stacked in a pyramid formation and topped with popcorn.

caption: Jackalope Cake
alt: A multi-tiered camouflage-patterned cake features a sculpted brown bunny wearing antlers and a camo vest, with the name "Aaron" written in gold icing on the chocolate base.

caption: Beagle Chasing Hare Cake
alt: A diorama depicts a tricolor hound wearing a black vest with the number 13 in pursuit of a brown hare through an autumnal forest floor scattered with orange leaves and bare trees.

caption: Computer Geek and Alien Cake
alt: A blue birthday cake decorated with fondant figures of a yellow bicycle helmet, a green alien head, a tablet displaying "Happy Birthday Ian," a smartphone, a blue car, USB drives, and a computer mouse.

caption: BBQ Cake
alt: A square cake decorated to resemble a picnic scene features a realistic hamburger, an ear of corn, a watermelon slice, and a dessert on a blue and white checkered blanket atop green grass.

caption: Hang Glider Stuck in Tree Cake
alt: A sculpted cake diorama depicts a man in a red helmet and yellow shirt suspended in a striped hang glider between two trees, hovering over a dense canopy of green and yellow leaves.

caption: Gym Cake
alt: A gym-themed cake features a large fondant weight plate labeled "Jake's Gym" with a bodybuilder illustration, alongside a sculpted dumbbell, a Power Bar, and a white towel, all resting on a blue rectangular base.

caption: Sail Boat Cake
alt: A sculpted cake of a white sailboat with two masts sits atop a sculpted blue and white base designed to resemble ocean waves.

caption: Bear Cake
alt: A realistic cake sculpted to resemble a brown bear's head rests behind a detailed cake replica of a knife with a red handle and sheath, all displayed on a black marble-patterned surface.
A detailed cake sculpted to look like a yellow and white fire engine labeled "Monticello Engine 49," complete with fondant hoses and a cone, set against a dramatic backdrop of a raging wildfire.
